visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual Dubrovnik Cathedral has a pale Baroque front with four free-standing columns, recessed central wood portal, two side doors and real outer figure niches with simplified stone figures. The upper rectangular window, shallow open balcony, thick volute shoulders, shoulder balustrades/statues and triangular crown join the long nave and lower aisles. Gray metal nave/aisle/transept roofs and side upper arched windows/lower semicircular lunettes lead to the central pale windowed drum, dark gray ribbed dome, slender pale lantern and estimated45m cross. Corrected crown/volute edge winding and canopy underside orientation. Fine carving and hidden rear detail remain approximate.
